# Repeatable General Sejm decision for POL / LIT / PLC (60-month cooldown).
oe_plc_dec_royal_sejm = {
    decision_category = oe_cat_imperial_governance
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_plc_union_realm = yes
        has_global_variable = oe_plc_on
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 80
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_plc_sejm_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:burghers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_plc_dec_royal_sejm.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -80
            add_stability = 6
            add_prestige = 5
            set_variable = { name = oe_plc_sejm_cd months = 60 }
            if = {
                limit = { tag = POL country_exists = c:LIT }
                add_opinion = { modifier = oe_plc_b_krewo_union target = c:LIT }
                c:LIT = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_plc_b_krewo_union target = c:POL } }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { tag = LIT country_exists = c:POL }
                add_opinion = { modifier = oe_plc_b_krewo_union target = c:POL }
                c:POL = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_plc_b_krewo_union target = c:LIT } }
            }
        }
    }
}
